channel.title: Energy
channel.description: Find the latest news and analysis, headlines, blogs and videos about energy markets, gas, oil, coal, commodities, nuclear power from CNBC.com.

item.title: Latin America has the copper and energy the AI build-out needs. Infrastructure is the test
item.description: Latin America’s copper, oil, gas and rare earths could benefit from rising AI energy demand, if infrastructure and fiscal policy attract investment.

item.title: Investors led by U.S. billionaire Todd Boehly to buy Lukoil's oil and gas assets outside Russia, sources say
item.description: The U.S. International Development Finance Corporation and Catena Investments, based in the United Arab Emirates, are also parties to the deal, the sources said.

item.title: Ukraine tells Putin to ‘stop complaining’ over oil refinery attacks as Russia promises retaliation
item.description: Ukraine’s foreign minister told Putin to end the war if he wants Kyiv to stop attacking Russian refineries, after Putin said retaliation was “inevitable.”

item.title: ‘Ready for any storm’: UAE minister optimistic on economy as IMF lifts forecast
item.description: The UAE is optimistic about achieving 7%-8% economic growth next year, banking on a "different" economic model.

item.title: Houthi attack on Saudi Arabian sovereign wealth fund PIF's tower injures 11
item.description: This has been the second attack by the Iran-backed group in six days on the tower, although the previous attack did not cause any casualties.
